title: export queue recovery feedback and mediastore

commit.merge_subject: merge: export queue recovery feedback and mediastore

description:
Owner finding 2026-11-10: finished exports lived only in the app's
private files/exports directory — invisible to Gallery and other apps.

- MediaPublish (pure, JVM-tested): the placement decision per target —
  MP4 -> the video collection, Movies/ritiMCRAW, video/mp4; DNG -> the
  images collection, Pictures/ritiMCRAW, image/x-adobe-dng (some
  gallery viewers will not render a CFA DNG; the raw mosaic is intact
  for desktop readers). The display name matches the internal copy's
  output name, so Retry still dedupes by the unchanged name.
- ExportPublisher: a small interface like ExportIo so the queue stays
  JVM-testable; tests inject fakes, AppNav wires the real adapter.
  ExportPublisher.None is the default no-op.
- MediaStorePublisher: the thin Android adapter (the only framework
  class in the publish path, like MediaCodecMp4Writer). IS_PENDING
  flow: insert a pending row, stream
changed: fix: recover stale running exports on startup
feat: visible export enqueue feedback and progress
feat: publish finished exports to mediastore
